items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Yeah, Gene Cedric. Little Fat Follower. That's him.

ctx.x: Remember the names and different things like that. Let's see. Who else came off the boat that was outstanding? This saxophone player and carnet player used to be with Fat Swallow. Gene Cedric?
Yeah, Gene Cedric. Little Fat Follower. That's him.
Yeah. I saw him in New York about a year ago, a little over a year ago.
